controls.name: C-14d
controls.query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-12T19:36:42.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-12T20:36:42.000Z"
        AND host.name == "web-2"
        AND event.outcome IS NOT NULL
| STATS accepted = COUNT(*) WHERE event.outcome == "success",
        failed = COUNT(*) WHERE event.outcome == "failure",
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY user.name, source.ip, auth_method = CASE(message LIKE "*publickey*", "publickey",
                                                    message LIKE "*password*", "password", "other")
| SORT accepted DESC, failed DESC
